nodes.title: Edit Instructions - English
widgets_values:
Image 1 is the room and establishes the architecture, camera angle, window, garden, bookcase and floor. Image 2 is the sage-green oak armchair with its cream knitted throw. Image 3 is the round oak side table with two books and an ivory teacup. Image 4 is the dusty-blue ceramic vase with white cosmos flowers.
Create a single serene, beautiful window-side reading room photograph by furnishing the room in Image 1 with the objects from Images 2, 3 and 4. Place one armchair beside the window, angled gently toward the center of the room, with the throw draped naturally over its arm. Place the side table within easy reach beside the chair, retaining its books, cup and saucer. Set the small flower vase on the free part of the tabletop without covering the cup. Preserve the recognizable design, materials and colors of each reference object, adjusting their perspective and scale to fit the room. Preserve the room's oak bookcase, window and garden view. Let soft morning sunlight stream through the window, casting delicate leaf shadows on the warm oak floor and softly illuminating linen, wood and flowers. Add a subtle pale ivory woven rug beneath the chair and table. Quiet, airy, poetic, lived-in atmosphere, warm cream and sage palette, refined natural interior photography. Realistic contact shadows and consistent window lighting. Show the furniture fully within a wide, balanced composition. No people, no animals, no collage, no split panels, no duplicate furniture, no text overlays.
